### 📋 Aapki Legal Position Ka Analysis

**1. Kya Hua Hai (What Happened):**
Aapke description ke mutabiq, Employer / Management ke sath ₹60,000 ke amount ko lekar dispute hua hai.

**2. Zaroori Facts (Important Facts):**
- Aapka Role: Employee
- Disputed Amount: ₹60,000
- Agreement Status: Not specified in conversation
- Available Evidence: Details pending

**3. Applicable Indian Laws & Citations:**
- **The Payment of Wages Act, 1936 — Section 5 & Section 15**: Time of payment of wages and Claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment ([Official Source](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2405))
- **Delhi Rent Control Act, 1958 — Section 14 & Section 45**: Protection of tenant against eviction and restoration of essential amenities ([Official Source](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/1393))
- **The Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 73**: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract ([Official Source](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2187))
- **The Payment of Wages Act, 1936 — Section 7**: Deductions which may be made from wages ([Official Source](https://www.indiacode.nic.in/handle/123456789/2405))

**4. Aapke Rights & Protections:**
- Indian law ke mutabiq, bina itemized proof ke security deposit ya earned salary withhold karna unlawful hai.
- Normal wear & tear (jaise routine painting) tenant ki liability nahi hoti (Transfer of Property Act Section 108).

**5. Available Remedies:**
- Formal written Demand Notice (15-day compliance window ke sath).
- State Rent Authority / Consumer Commission (e-Daakhil) / Labour Commissioner me petition file karna.

**6. Practical Options:**
- Pehle traceable channel (Email + Speed Post / WhatsApp) se clear written notice bhein.
- Bina advocate ke bhi National Consumer Helpline (1915) ya NALSA se pre-litigation help le sakte hain.

**7. Risks & Limitations:**
- Agar counterparty refuse kare, to statutory forum me proceed karna hoga jisme documentation solid honi chahiye.

**8. Recommended Next Steps:**
1. 'Document Generator' tab se Demand Draft generate karein.

citations.title: Time of payment of wages and Claims arising out of deductions from wages or delay in payment
citations.description: Wages must be paid before the expiry of the 7th day after the wage period (or 10th day if more than 1,000 persons employed). Section 15 provides for application to the designated Authority for delayed wages with compensation up to ten times the amount deducted/delayed.

citations.title: Protection of tenant against eviction and restoration of essential amenities
citations.description: Strict grounds required for eviction; prohibits withholding essential amenities without reasonable cause. Tenant may approach Rent Controller for summary restoration.

citations.title: Compensation for loss or damage caused by breach of contract
citations.description: When a contract has been broken, the party who suffers by such breach is entitled to receive, from the party who has broken the contract, compensation for any loss or damage caused to him thereby.

citations.title: Deductions which may be made from wages
citations.description: Strictly enumerates permissible deductions (such as authorized provident fund, income tax, or willful damage shown after formal inquiry). Any arbitrary or unauthorized deduction is unlawful.
